title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #10

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about God and human beings is true? (1 mark)
   A. God has forgotten small children
   B. God knows only adults
   C. God knows each person by name
   D. God knows only the leaders

2. Feelings such as happiness, sadness and anger are: (1 mark)
   A. Only for adults
   B. Always sinful
   C. Normal, but our actions must be right
   D. Never allowed

3. Which verse tells Christians to rejoice in the Lord always? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Philippians 4:4
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Luke 19:5

4. Which verse says, "God is love"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Acts 11:26
   C. 1 John 4:8
   D. Genesis 1:1

5. Which of these is an attribute of God taught in this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Sole Creator
   B. Forgetful
   C. Unknown
   D. Weak

6. What did Jesus say about why He came? (1 mark)
   A. To collect taxes
   B. To rule Rome
   C. To build a palace
   D. To seek and to save the lost

7. Which of these is a sign of real repentance? (1 mark)
   A. Only saying sorry with words
   B. Hiding the wrong
   C. Repeating the wrong
   D. Making things right with those we wronged

8. What did the donkey say to Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Give me water
   B. What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   C. Please go home
   D. I am tired

9. Which people did Balak want Balaam to curse? (1 mark)
   A. The Israelites
   B. The Egyptians
   C. The Romans
   D. The Philistines

10. What did Samson find later in the body of the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Bees and honey
   B. A snake
   C. Gold
   D. Nothing

11. Which of these shows obedience like Abraham's? (1 mark)
   A. Following good instructions even when it is hard
   B. Waiting for others
   C. Arguing
   D. Ignoring instructions

12. What was Sarai's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Rebekah
   B. Rachel
   C. Sarah
   D. Leah

13. Why is the birth of Jesus unique? (1 mark)
   A. He was born in a rich home
   B. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   C. He was born in a palace
   D. He was born in Egypt

14. Leprosy today can be treated with: (1 mark)
   A. Medicine
   B. Charms
   C. Prayer only, without doctors
   D. Nothing

15. How many men with leprosy met Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Two
   C. Ten
   D. Twelve

16. Who had died in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. The only son of a widow
   C. A king
   D. A priest

17. Which is an example of helping a classmate? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at him
   B. Hiding your pencil
   C. Sharing your pencil
   D. Telling lies

18. In the parable, who does the woman stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A shopkeeper
   B. A priest
   C. God
   D. A sinner

19. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A song
   C. A kind of coin
   D. A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson

20. What is eternal life? (1 mark)
   A. Life on earth only
   B. A kind of food
   C. A long holiday
   D. Life with God that never ends

21. Which verse says that God so loved the world? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. John 3:16

22. Which is a result of disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Praise
   B. Reward
   C. Trust
   D. Punishment or harm

23. If you break a friend's ruler, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Blame another
   B. Say sorry and offer to replace it
   C. Say nothing
   D. Hide it

24. What should you do with a found pencil that is not yours? (1 mark)
   A. Sell it
   B. Throw it away
   C. Hand it to the teacher
   D. Keep it

25. What should we do with phones in church? (1 mark)
   A. Switch them off or keep them silent
   B. Make calls
   C. Watch videos
   D. Play games

26. What did Jesus say the temple should be called? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. A palace
   C. A school
   D. A house of prayer

27. Which two disciples were brothers, sons of Zebedee? (1 mark)
   A. Peter and Andrew
   B. James and John
   C. Matthew and Thaddaeus
   D. Thomas and Philip

28. What does the word apostle mean? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. One who is sent
   C. A fisher
   D. One who sits

29. Which verse warns about bad company? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. 1 Corinthians 15:33
   D. Genesis 1:1

30. What can help you to build self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping busy with good activities
   B. Bad company
   C. Being idle
   D. Ignoring rules

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain what a child should do if they are offered drugs or asked to do something that defiles the body. (5 marks)

32. Describe what happened on the road when Balaam was riding his donkey. (4 marks)

33. Describe what a child should do after sinning, in four steps. (4 marks)

34. Explain what a child should do if a stranger contacts them online and why. (5 marks)

35. State two reasons why we should tell the truth. (2 marks)

36. Explain why sexual purity is important and how children can begin to live a holy life like Mary. (5 marks)

37. Explain why the body is called a temple of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

38. Describe Joseph's plan to save Egypt from the famine. (4 marks)

39. Explain why Christians should help those in need. (3 marks)

40. What does the name Nazirite refer to in the story of Samson? (2 marks)

41. State two ways in which Bartimaeus showed faith in Jesus. (2 marks)

42. Describe what a child should do when they lose or break something belonging to someone else. (3 marks)

43. Explain why God changed Abram's name to Abraham. (3 marks)

44. Describe three steps for saying no to temptation. (3 marks)

45. Give two ways of helping a needy classmate. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — God knows each person by name
   Isaiah 43:1 says that God calls His people by name.

2. C — Normal, but our actions must be right
   Feelings themselves are not bad. What we do with them matters.

3. B — Philippians 4:4
   Philippians 4:4 says, "Rejoice in the Lord always."

4. C — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

5. A — Sole Creator
   God is the sole Creator, loving Father and holy.

6. D — To seek and to save the lost
   Luke 19:10 says that the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.

7. D — Making things right with those we wronged
   Zacchaeus showed repentance by paying back.

8. B — What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   Numbers 22:28 records the donkey's question.

9. A — The Israelites
   Balak feared the Israelites camped on the plains of Moab.

10. A — Bees and honey
   Judges 14:8 says a swarm of bees and honey were there.

11. A — Following good instructions even when it is hard
   Abraham obeyed God without knowing the whole plan.

12. C — Sarah
   Genesis 17:15 records this.

13. B — He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   Jesus was conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.

14. A — Medicine
   Leprosy can be cured with medicine from health workers.

15. C — Ten
   Luke 17:12 says ten men met Him.

16. B — The only son of a widow
   The young man was her only son.

17. C — Sharing your pencil
   Sharing meets a need.

18. C — God
   The searching woman stands for God's love.

19. D — A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   Jesus used parables to teach.

20. D — Life with God that never ends
   Eternal life is everlasting life with God.

21. D — John 3:16
   John 3:16 is the memory verse.

22. D — Punishment or harm
   Disobedience brings trouble.

23. B — Say sorry and offer to replace it
   Honesty and repair are responsible.

24. C — Hand it to the teacher
   Return what is not yours.

25. A — Switch them off or keep them silent
   Phones can disturb worship.

26. D — A house of prayer
   Matthew 21:13 says, "My house will be called a house of prayer."

27. B — James and John
   James and John were sons of Zebedee.

28. B — One who is sent
   Apostles were sent out with a message.

29. C — 1 Corinthians 15:33
   Bad company corrupts good character.

30. A — Keeping busy with good activities
   Good activities help.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, walk away, avoid the group, tell a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher, pray for strength, and choose friends who make good choices.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying no, 1 for walking away, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for prayer, 1 for good friends.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: The angel stood in the road. The donkey turned into a field and Balaam struck her. Then she pressed against a wall and crushed his foot, and he struck her again. Then she lay down and he struck her a third time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the angel, 1 for turning aside, 1 for the wall and foot, 1 for lying down.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: Admit it, say sorry to God, say sorry to the person hurt, put things right, decide not to repeat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: They should not reply, should close the chat, should tell a parent or teacher, and can call 116. Strangers may pretend to be someone else and may want to harm the child. Telling a trusted adult keeps the child safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not replying, 1 for closing, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for the helpline, 1 for the reason.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: God commands it; people trust us; we feel peaceful; friendships stay strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: The body is a gift from God, and sexual relations are meant for marriage. Purity keeps us safe and honours God. Children can begin by respecting their bodies, avoiding harmful places and media, obeying parents, praying and saying no to wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for body as gift, 1 for marriage, 1 for honouring God, 1 for respecting body or avoiding harm, 1 for a prayer or obedience.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit lives in believers, so the body is holy like a temple and should be treated with respect.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Holy Spirit, 1 for holy, 1 for respect.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a wise man to be in charge, take a fifth of the grain during the seven good years, store it in the towns, and use it in the famine years.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught it; it shows love; it makes the community stronger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: A person set apart for God from birth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for set apart and 1 mark for for God.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: He called out to Jesus; he kept shouting when told to be quiet; he came at once; he asked for sight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the owner honestly, say sorry, offer to replace or repair it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: God made a covenant with him and promised that he would be a father of many nations. The new name reminded him of this promise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the covenant, 1 for the promise, 1 for the name as a reminder.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, give a short reason, walk away, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Share a pencil or lunch, help with a lesson, welcome them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
